commitments.detail: Update RFC to include Avro compatibility gateway, exactly 21 days of dual publishing, and ensure the gateway handles tokenized payloads correctly per the privacy tokenization requirement.

Rewrite the direct protobuf publishing section to require tokenization before events enter the bus, and change storage region from default US to EU. File the formal privacy review record after this meeting.

Update RFC to reduce event-retention period from 30 days to exactly 14 days, and cap replay workers at a maximum of 4 concurrent workers. Post the benchmark results once dashboard screenshots are verified.
Coordinate with Nadia to ensure the Avro compatibility gateway correctly handles tokenized payloads, addressing the intersection between backend and privacy requirements.
